name: Teak 3-Door Wardrobe
description: Solid teak 3-door wardrobe with hanging space, shelves and two drawers. Spacious classic design with locking doors, ideal for bedroom storage.
details: This solid teak 3-door wardrobe offers generous bedroom storage with a hanging section, open shelves and two drawers. The doors have locks and silver handles. A decorative crown top and carved base give it a traditional look. Strong teak construction makes it durable and suitable for everyday use in Sri Lankan homes.
